0.summary: Curve all fingers and thumb so fingertips meet, forming an oval shape identical to the letter O.

fingerNotes.thumb: Curved inward to touch the index fingertip.
fingerNotes.index: Curved down to meet the thumb tip.
fingerNotes.middle: Curved into the oval alongside index.
fingerNotes.ring: Curved into the oval alongside middle.
fingerNotes.pinky: Curved into the oval alongside ring.

0.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the camera.

1.summary: Extend your index finger straight up. Curl middle, ring, and pinky fingers into your palm with thumb folded across.

fingerNotes.thumb: Folded over the curled fingers.
fingerNotes.index: Extended straight upright.

1.orientationNote: Palm faces inward toward the signer or slightly angled.

2.summary: Extend your index and middle fingers straight up and spread apart in a V-shape. Keep ring and pinky fingers curled.

fingerNotes.thumb: Folded over ring and pinky fingers.
fingerNotes.index: Extended straight up, spread away from middle finger.
fingerNotes.middle: Extended straight up, spread away from index finger.

2.orientationNote: Palm faces inward toward the signer or slightly angled.

3.summary: Extend thumb, index, and middle fingers outward. Ring and pinky fingers remain curled into the palm.

fingerNotes.thumb: Extended outward to the side (distinctive ASL 3).
fingerNotes.index: Extended straight upright.

3.orientationNote: Palm faces inward toward the signer or slightly angled.

4.summary: Extend all four fingers (index, middle, ring, pinky) straight up and slightly spread. Tuck thumb across your palm.

fingerNotes.thumb: Tucked across the lower palm.
fingerNotes.index: Extended straight up.

4.orientationNote: Palm faces inward toward the signer or slightly angled.

5.summary: Open your hand wide with all 5 fingers fully extended and spread apart.

fingerNotes.thumb: Extended and spread outward.
fingerNotes.index: Extended straight up and spread.

5.orientationNote: Palm faces inward toward the signer or forward.

6.summary: Touch the tip of your thumb to the tip of your pinky finger. Keep index, middle, and ring fingers extended straight up.

fingerNotes.thumb: Touches pinky fingertip in a loop.
fingerNotes.index: Extended straight upright.

6.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the camera.

7.summary: Touch the tip of your thumb to the tip of your ring finger. Keep index, middle, and pinky fingers extended straight up.

fingerNotes.thumb: Touches ring fingertip in a loop.
fingerNotes.index: Extended straight upright.

7.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the camera.

8.summary: Touch the tip of your thumb to the tip of your middle finger. Keep index, ring, and pinky fingers extended straight up.

fingerNotes.thumb: Touches middle fingertip in a loop.
fingerNotes.index: Extended straight upright.

8.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the camera.

9.summary: Touch the tip of your thumb to the tip of your index finger in an OK-circle. Keep middle, ring, and pinky fingers extended straight up.

fingerNotes.thumb: Touches index fingertip in an OK-circle.
fingerNotes.index: Curled to touch thumb tip.

9.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the camera (identical to the letter F).

A.summary: Make a fist with your four fingers curled into your palm. Keep your thumb upright resting alongside the outer edge of your index finger.

fingerNotes.thumb: Rest thumb straight up against the side of your index knuckle, not tucked over fingers.
fingerNotes.index: Curled tightly into the palm.

A.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with an upright wrist.

B.summary: Hold all four fingers straight up and pressed together. Fold your thumb flat across your palm under the fingers.

fingerNotes.thumb: Folded flat across the palm.
fingerNotes.index: Fully extended upward and touching middle finger.
fingerNotes.middle: Fully extended upward and touching index and ring fingers.
fingerNotes.ring: Fully extended upward and touching middle and pinky fingers.
fingerNotes.pinky: Fully extended upward and touching ring finger.

B.orientationNote: Palm faces directly outward with hand held vertically.

L.summary: Extend your thumb horizontally and index finger vertically to form a right-angle "L" shape. Curl middle, ring, and pinky into your palm.

fingerNotes.thumb: Extended horizontally outward to the side at a 90° angle.
fingerNotes.index: Extended straight upward vertically.

L.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer.

V.summary: Extend your index and middle fingers upward in a separated "V" (peace) shape. Fold your thumb over your curled ring and pinky fingers.

fingerNotes.thumb: Folded across palm holding down ring and pinky fingers.
fingerNotes.index: Fully extended upward and angled slightly outward.
fingerNotes.middle: Fully extended upward and angled slightly outward.

V.orientationNote: Palm faces directly outward with fingers spread into a "V".

Y.summary: Extend your thumb outward to the side and pinky outward to the opposite side ("hang loose" shape). Curl your index, middle, and ring fingers into your palm.

fingerNotes.thumb: Extended fully outward to the side.
fingerNotes.index: Curled tightly into the palm.
fingerNotes.pinky: Extended fully outward to the side.

Y.orientationNote: Palm faces forward toward the viewer.

C.summary: Curve all four fingers and thumb into a gentle half-circle, resembling the letter 'C'.

fingerNotes.thumb: Curved outward and forward opposing the fingers, forming the lower curve.
fingerNotes.index: Curved smoothly forward along with middle, ring, and pinky.
fingerNotes.middle: Curved smoothly forward aligned with index.
fingerNotes.ring: Curved smoothly forward aligned with middle.
fingerNotes.pinky: Curved smoothly forward aligned with ring.

C.orientationNote: Palm faces toward the viewer with an upright wrist.

O.summary: Form an 'O' by bringing the tips of all four fingers down to meet the tip of your thumb.

fingerNotes.thumb: Curved upward so its tip touches or meets the index and middle fingertips.
fingerNotes.index: Curled forward and down to touch the thumb tip.
fingerNotes.middle: Curled forward and down to meet the thumb tip.
fingerNotes.ring: Curled forward in line with middle and index.
fingerNotes.pinky: Curled forward in line with the other fingers.

O.orientationNote: Palm faces outward slightly angled, maintaining a clear circular opening visible to the viewer.

D.summary: Point your index finger straight up while your middle, ring, and pinky curl down so the middle finger touches your thumb.

fingerNotes.thumb: Curved against the pad of your curled middle finger to complete the circle at the base.
fingerNotes.index: Extended straight up toward the ceiling.
fingerNotes.middle: Curled into a circle, touching the tip of your thumb.
fingerNotes.ring: Curled down into the palm alongside the middle finger.
fingerNotes.pinky: Curled down into the palm alongside the ring finger.

D.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with an upright wrist.

F.summary: Touch the tips of your thumb and index finger together to form an 'OK' circle, while extending your middle, ring, and pinky fingers straight up.

fingerNotes.thumb: Touches the tip of your index finger forming a circle.
fingerNotes.index: Curled down to meet the tip of your thumb.
fingerNotes.middle: Extended straight up and slightly spread.
fingerNotes.ring: Extended straight up and slightly spread.
fingerNotes.pinky: Extended straight up and slightly spread.

F.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with an upright wrist.

U.summary: Extend your index and middle fingers straight up together so they touch side-by-side, with ring and pinky curled into your palm and thumb resting over them.

fingerNotes.thumb: Folded across your curled ring and pinky fingers.
fingerNotes.index: Extended straight up, held touching the middle finger.
fingerNotes.middle: Extended straight up, held touching the index finger.

U.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with an upright wrist.

I.summary: Extend your pinky finger straight up toward the ceiling while curling your index, middle, and ring fingers tightly into your palm with your thumb folded across them.

fingerNotes.thumb: Folded across the front of your curled index, middle, and ring fingers.
fingerNotes.index: Curled tightly into the palm.
fingerNotes.pinky: Extended straight up toward the ceiling.

I.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with an upright wrist.

W.summary: Extend your index, middle, and ring fingers straight up and spread them apart into a 'W' shape, while your pinky is curled down into your palm held by your thumb.

fingerNotes.thumb: Folded across palm holding the pinky finger down.
fingerNotes.index: Extended straight up and spread outward to the side.
fingerNotes.middle: Extended straight up in the center.
fingerNotes.ring: Extended straight up and spread outward to the opposite side.

W.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with an upright wrist.

S.summary: Form a tight fist with all four fingers curled into your palm, and cross your thumb firmly across the front of your curled fingers.

fingerNotes.thumb: Folded across the front of your index and middle fingers, resting over the knuckles.
fingerNotes.index: Curled tightly into the palm.

S.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with an upright wrist.

R.summary: Cross your middle finger over your index finger while extending both upright, with ring and pinky curled into your palm and thumb resting over them.

fingerNotes.thumb: Folded across ring and pinky fingers.
fingerNotes.index: Extended upright behind the crossed middle finger.
fingerNotes.middle: Extended upright crossed over the front of the index finger.

R.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with an upright wrist.

K.summary: Extend your index finger straight up, angle your middle finger forward at a 45-degree angle, and place the tip of your thumb between them touching your middle finger knuckle.

fingerNotes.thumb: Extended upward resting between index and middle fingers, touching the middle finger joint.
fingerNotes.index: Extended straight up.
fingerNotes.middle: Extended forward and up at an angle.

K.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with an upright wrist.

X.summary: Bend your index finger into a hook like a question mark while curling your middle, ring, and pinky fingers into your palm with your thumb folded across them.

fingerNotes.thumb: Folded across the front of your curled middle and ring fingers.
fingerNotes.index: Extended from the knuckle but bent forward at the first joint into a hook shape.

X.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with an upright wrist.

E.summary: Curl all four fingers down so their tips rest firmly on the thumb folded horizontally underneath them.

fingerNotes.thumb: Tucked horizontally beneath the curled fingertips against the palm.
fingerNotes.index: Curled down with fingertip resting on thumb.
fingerNotes.middle: Curled down with fingertip resting on thumb.
fingerNotes.ring: Curled down with fingertip resting on thumb.
fingerNotes.pinky: Curled down with fingertip resting on thumb.

E.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with knuckles clearly displayed.

G.summary: Turn your hand sideways so your index finger points horizontally to the side, with your thumb extended parallel to it and your other three fingers curled into your palm.

fingerNotes.thumb: Extended parallel to the index finger, forming a horizontal pinch profile.
fingerNotes.index: Extended horizontally pointing to the side.

G.orientationNote: Hand is rotated sideways so index and thumb point horizontally across your body.

H.summary: Extend both your index and middle fingers together pointing horizontally to the side, with ring and pinky curled into your palm and thumb resting over them.

fingerNotes.thumb: Folded across your curled ring and pinky fingers.
fingerNotes.index: Extended horizontally pointing sideways alongside the middle finger.
fingerNotes.middle: Extended horizontally pointing sideways alongside the index finger.

H.orientationNote: Hand is rotated sideways so the index and middle fingers point horizontally together.

P.summary: Form the 'K' handshape with index pointing forward/down, middle pointing straight down, and thumb between them, with wrist angled downward.

fingerNotes.thumb: Extended between index and middle fingers, resting on middle finger joint.
fingerNotes.index: Extended forward and angled downward.

P.orientationNote: Wrist is tilted so fingers point downward toward the floor.

Q.summary: Form the 'G' handshape with your index finger and thumb pointing straight downward, with your other three fingers curled into your palm.

fingerNotes.thumb: Extended downward parallel to the index finger.
fingerNotes.index: Extended pointing straight downward.

Q.orientationNote: Wrist is tilted downward so index and thumb point toward the floor.

T.summary: Form a fist with your thumb tucked under your index finger and its tip poking up between your index and middle fingers.

fingerNotes.thumb: Tucked beneath your index finger, with tip emerging between index and middle fingers.
fingerNotes.index: Curled into palm draped over thumb.

T.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with an upright wrist.

N.summary: Form a fist with your thumb tucked under your index and middle fingers, with its tip poking out between your middle and ring fingers.

fingerNotes.thumb: Tucked beneath index and middle fingers, with tip emerging between middle and ring fingers.
fingerNotes.index: Curled into palm draped over thumb.
fingerNotes.middle: Curled into palm draped over thumb.

N.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with an upright wrist.

M.summary: Form a fist with your thumb tucked under your index, middle, and ring fingers, with its tip poking out between your ring and pinky fingers.

fingerNotes.thumb: Tucked beneath index, middle, and ring fingers, with tip emerging between ring and pinky fingers.
fingerNotes.index: Curled into palm draped over thumb.
fingerNotes.middle: Curled into palm draped over thumb.
fingerNotes.ring: Curled into palm draped over thumb.

M.orientationNote: Palm faces outward toward the viewer with an upright wrist.
